label: Gemini 3.1 Pro
description: Ask Gemini 3.1 Pro about a frame, a frame range (sent as video) or just a prompt. Text out only: the reply lands in 'reply' below, the plate passes through. Paid Google Vertex AI call per run.

max_frames_input.tooltip: Video only. Gemini samples video at about 1 frame per second; long clips cost more.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: Your question or instruction, e.g. 'describe this shot' or 'write a Nano Banana prompt that adds rain to this frame'.

knobs.name: model
knobs.label: model
knobs.tooltip: 3.1 Pro: best answers. 3 Flash: faster and cheaper. 3.1 Flash Lite: cheapest.

knobs.name: temperature
knobs.label: temperature
knobs.tooltip: Randomness. Lower = more factual and repeatable; higher = more varied wording and ideas.

knobs.name: max_output_tokens
knobs.label: max output tokens
knobs.tooltip: Longest reply (1-8192 tokens; ~750 words per 1000 tokens).

knobs.name: top_p
knobs.label: top p
knobs.tooltip: Only sample from the most likely options adding up to this probability. 1 = no cut.

knobs.name: top_k
knobs.label: top k
knobs.tooltip: Only sample from the k most likely options (1-64).

knobs.name: system_instruction
knobs.label: system instruction
knobs.tooltip: Optional standing instruction for every run, e.g. 'You are a VFX supervisor. Answer briefly.'

knobs.name: gcp_project
knobs.label: GCP project
knobs.tooltip: Google Cloud project billed for the Vertex AI call. Empty = the GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT environment variable. Set your own default in ~/.nuke/comfygizmos_prefs.json: {"knob_defaults": {"gemini31_pro": {"gcp_project": "your-project"}}}
